description: This file contains the main application setup for an iOS app built with SwiftUI. It includes the app delegate class managing notifications, background tasks, and app lifecycle events. It also defines functions for handling notifications, especially watch prompt notifications, and integrates them into the app's workflow. Additionally, there is logic for scheduling background tasks, handling push notifications, and responding to user interactions. The main app struct initializes key components and manages scene lifecycle events.

classes.name: OpenClawAppDelegate
classes.description: Manages application lifecycle, push notifications, background refresh tasks, and interactions with user notifications, including handling of watch prompt notifications and scheduling background tasks.

methods.name: application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)
methods.description: Initializes background tasks, sets notification delegate, and registers for remote notifications at app launch.

methods.name: application(_:didRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithDeviceToken:)
methods.description: Handles successful remote notification registration, updating the app model with the device token.

methods.name: application(_:didFailToRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithError:)
methods.description: Logs errors if remote notification registration fails.

methods.name: application(_:didReceiveRemoteNotification:fetchCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles incoming silent push notifications, delegating handling to the app model and scheduling wake refresh if needed.

methods.name: scenePhaseChanged(_:)
methods.description: Schedules background wake refresh when the scene moves to background.

methods.name: registerBackgroundWakeRefreshTask()
methods.description: Registers the background wake refresh task with the system.

methods.name: scheduleBackgroundWakeRefresh(afterSeconds:reason:)
methods.description: Schedules a background task with a specified delay and reason.

methods.name: handleBackgroundWakeRefresh(task:)
methods.description: Performs background refresh work and reschedules itself.

methods.name: routeWatchPromptAction(_:)
methods.description: Routes a watch prompt action to the app model for handling.
